notes.title: Quality of life update and what's coming next!
notes.content:
[b]Dear apprentice Ninzas,[/b]
It’s been 1 month since the game launched on Steam, and it’s time to give you an update on how things have gone on our end, [b]the recent minor patch we’ve just rolled out,[/b] and what’s coming next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/104b366bdea7df6d0f2195d3885014ee5dd32f47.png[/img]
The good news is that we’re really happy with how the launch went, especially since we were expecting a much rougher start. Despite all our efforts, we barely managed to gather around 1,500 wishlists, which was not good at all.

But against all odds, we made it into the [b]News and Trending section in several countries[/b] and quickly hit 50 reviews with a “Very Positive” rating… and only one single negative review so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/f449afc34abdfa9e46bcd034368a049ae5fcdf6a.png[/img]
In terms of other stats, Ninza has been averaging over a hundred daily players, with a CCU (concurrent users) hovering around a daily peak of 7-10 players on average, sometimes spiking up to 28 (still not sure why). Over 3,800 players have tried the game at least once since launch.

To be completely transparent, given that we only had 1,500 wishlists at launch and the rather poor coverage of the game (despite my attempt to reach out to over 400 influencers/media), these numbers seem like a total miracle.

But to be even more honest with you, we’re incredibly proud. Given our laughable resources, our tiny team size, and how almost impossible it has become for indies to fight for visibility, the success of Ninza, however humble, makes us super happy. What’s also been amazing is the warm reception from the players. Whether it’s the game’s original system, its universe, or other aspects we’d grown used to, the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive.

And of course, there's you, the incredible pillars of this community who continue to shower us with words of encouragement, thoughtful feedback, and your engagement with the game. That means the world to us and has way more value than any statistic. So, once again, a huge THANK YOU.

Oh, and by the way, [b]if you haven’t dropped a review yet,[/b] go for it now! It really helps with Steam’s algorithm. We’ll be forever grateful, and thank you to everyone who has already done so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/0b6d33975e3bee81f8ba8514d3ac351a509bf1ea.png[/img]
We just dropped a minor patch for the game. We did our best to prioritize based on your requests and the most common issues raised. The biggest task, which took most of our time, was localization. We started with the French and Spanish version, which is now available, and more languages are on the way. We hope this will make the game accessible to even more players!

[i]< the full patch notes are available on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/awR8MRx]Discord[/url] in the #patchnote channel >
[/i]
Now that’s out of the way, we’re pumped to finally bring in some real new content. On top of the cosmetic items and the new character dropping in Season 2, we’ve got a few more surprises up our sleeves. Hehe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/d9ee5ef2eb56e9ac450f2c6caceb44b4a9b3444b.png[/img]
Now that the launch is behind us, I’ll admit I’m excited to ease off the marketing a bit and channel more creative energy back into developing the game! There are so many things we’re dying to implement and share with you. The best version of Ninza hasn’t been released yet!

We can’t wait!

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.content:
Dear apprentice Ninzas,
This is a solemn (and a bit emotional) moment because, after all these years, [b]the time has finally come to share Ninza's release date with you![/b]

To celebrate, we’ve put together a new trailer 👇

[previewyoutube=IR3i1IOXKrs;full][/previewyoutube]

MARK YOUR CALENDARS! Ninza version 1.0 will launch on Steam in just four weeks!

[h1][b]NINZA RELEASE DATE:[/b][/h1]
[h1]28TH AUGUST 2024 / 5:30 PM CEST [/h1]

These last few days leading up to the release are going to be pretty intense. We’re giving it our all to deliver the most polished version of the game possible!

For us, this release marks the end of an era… but also [b]the beginning of a new one![/b] Those who’ve been with us from the start know how much the game has evolved, gradually becoming a title with strong competitive potential, featuring an online ranked mode, a leaderboard, and rollback netcode. Given the size of our studio, this achievement borders on madness. The challenges we faced—technical and otherwise—haven’t always been easy. We’ve had to tackle a lot of unknowns!

But what this release truly signifies for the game is that, in terms of features, we’ve done it all. The future of Ninza will be about adding new content, tweaking balance, fixing bugs, and polish. [b]In short, we’re going to make the most of everything we’ve already built![/b]

Of course, none of this would have been possible without your unwavering support and patience. Throughout the development, your feedback and encouragement have been invaluable. [b]So, a huge thank you to all of you! August 28th will be a real celebration, and it’s dedicated to you as well. <3[/b]

Alright, we’ll see you in a few weeks for Ninza’s release (omg)!

[i]Wuthrer, for Klakmioch[/i]

notes.title: Match Making Community Night: save the date!
notes.content:
Dear apprentice Ninzas,

The release date of Ninza is approaching, and with great excitement (mixed with a bit of stress, hihi). We are fully committed to adding the final touches to our game. But before the big celebration, we wanted to have a little pre-party...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/dd3fdfefb56c5747f7dd2bbc74785dc971cb4266.png[/img]
The quickmatch online game mode will let players enter a queue to be matched with suitable opponents by M0on. This is a brand-new feature we've been dreaming of for a long time, and it will make the game even easier and smoother to play. [b]We've also added a ranking system that will feature an official leaderboard![/b]

However, this is also quite a technical challenge, and [b]we would love to test it with you in a small group before continuing to fine-tune it for the release.[/b] That's why we're inviting you all to a short event, which will be streamed on our Twitch channel: [b]the Match Making Community Night.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/6a1094a79b4aa0a7be2beda864552ed0f2f282ae.png[/img]
The concept is simple: we will deploy a beta version of the game on Steam to test the matchmaking for one evening. The idea is to gather together and grind the ladder like crazy! We'll stream our games and exchange feedback on Discord/Twitch, discussing our feelings, experiences, and any bugs encountered.

[b]NINZA MATCH MAKING COMMUNITY NIGHT
[b][/b]24th July 2024 - 8:00 PM - 11:45 PM CEST
[/b]

Details:
[list]
[*] This playtest will use a new dedicated save file (but for testing purposes, all characters will be unlocked from the start)
[*] The test is limited to players in the European zone (at least for this first edition, due to server-related reasons)
[*] The test duration is very limited, as we are trying to maximize server occupancy at a specific time
[*] The test is open to ALL players, regardless of your level. This will also allow us to test the matchmaking system!
[*] The test will also showcase the new progression system and its cosmetics
[/list]

We hope many of you will join us! If you haven't already, feel free to join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/awR8MRx]Discord server,[/url] which will contain all the information, including how to access the beta, in due time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/d9ee5ef2eb56e9ac450f2c6caceb44b4a9b3444b.png[/img]
We can't wait to share this moment with you and get hyped for the upcoming release! Your help will be invaluable in uncovering bugs, but not only that. Your feedback will allow us to improve what can be improved so that we have a solid and fun quickmatch mode!

[i]From your Ninza Happiness, Ninza Social Coordinator,
Wuthrer, Love <3[/i]

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
Dear apprentice Ninzas,
2024 will be the year of Mo0n. The sky will be lunar, bathed in chaos and rains of bones from your crushed adversaries on the battlefield. But before the festivities reach their climax, let's start gently with [b]a small balance update, warmly requested.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/8493b7be977835ba2527799a1a00e00d79c69d19.png[/img]

Over the past weeks, we've gathered your feedback, conducted tests, and performed pagan rituals to implore the Mo0n to deliver its truths, all to result in a patch primarily dedicated to balancing.

When tackling game balance, our intention is and will always be the same - to favor aggressive play. Ninza is a game we want to be dynamic, brutal, and competitive. For us, this means that players who take risks and initiatives should be rewarded.

The corrections that have been implemented aim to bring us as close as possible to this intention, and we hope you'll enjoy discovering a revamped meta that now includes a greater number of dangerous characters ;)

For the curious ones, all the details of these changes are available on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/awR8MRx]Discord![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/97a4d498f6952e9d8cebaa383610359627945b4c.png[/img]
As you read this news, the demo has already been updated on Steam! So, feel free to dive in and test the new features. As always, don't hesitate to join the Discord to find opponents to play against online!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/357c86c94b4cc870a841ecc93590657fb365d7f9.png[/img]
This patch marks the end of Season 2 of the weekly tournaments, which holds the record for the longest duration in the history of independent video games xD

Jokes aside, a big shoutout to ALL participants in this season 2. Throughout the year, you delighted us with extraordinary matches. You amazed us with your creativity and passion! It's simply incredible to see how you push the game's limits every week to offer us splendid battles that are a true pleasure to watch and comment on.

But enough chatter, it's time to celebrate the grand winners of this second season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/94cc2c677a1b8a0311a1db2dfa38ecca595eb10d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/5a329587a054bf44f5e163a5f375978d779edb8b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/3aeb4881c1b7d0038d9f59ecae701cb1cb6b3c78.png[/img]

Season 3 will start without delay, next week. Everyone is welcome, and we look forward to seeing you, whether on the battlefield or on the stream.

[b]WEEKLY TOURNAMENTS:
EVERY THUESDAY or WEDNESDAY
FROM 8:00 PM TO 9:30 PM (UTC +1)[/b]
Registrations are available via our Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/d9ee5ef2eb56e9ac450f2c6caceb44b4a9b3444b.png[/img]
We will closely monitor the new meta that will emerge with this new patch. We are very curious about your feedback, and we are extremely excited to see the impacts in the weeklies. It is always thanks to you and your patience that we improve the game from version to version, and that's not about to change.

Speaking of things to come, we're holding quite a bit of information for the coming weeks. Rather than dropping everything in a big newsletter, we prefer to reveal a bit more gradually. On the agenda, we'll talk about the game's release, pricing, modifications to the progression system based on your feedback, reworked online features, new cosmetics, and other features that we are eager to unveil!

In summary, lots of super cool things coming up that will allow Ninza to reach its final form and are intended to ensure an interesting and rich future! We're excited and looking forward to this year, which we guarantee will bring Ninza to maturity for even more fun and beautiful moments.

From your Ninza Happiness Ninza Social Coordinator,

Wuthrer, Love <3

notes.title: Beta update: Trials and new baddies!
notes.content:
[b]Dear apprentice Ninzas,[/b]
Summer time usually rhymes with sun (even if it doesn't), yet our dear Mo0n is not to be outdone. Indeed, in order to spice up your holidays with a nice touch of chaotic energy, [b]a new version of Ninza is out, NOW![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/1f8891ba096fb7e1db5f084b1b34a62a1d86cd8f.png[/img]

[code]Ninza is in a open beta phase.
[url=http://www.ninza-game.com]Download the game from our official website,[/url] launch it and play.[/code]

Those new features allow newcomers to play solo or in coop while having a more friendly space to learn their moves! This is the first step of our big plan to make the game more welcoming to new players.

[i]For a more detailed patch note, you can join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/awR8MRx]Discord server.[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/26de8cf57e03a17b939a67af8ab77c5418e33393.png[/img]
Fresh, reliable and more interesting to play against, please make a warm welcome to our new punching bag, aka the Bot!

It now comes with its own set of abilities and appearance, so that nobody will mistakes it with our good old Tobias.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/30324ddfe4cb45e476590a8db29f62de6efb9950.gif[/img]
[i]He's cute but has no soul.[/i]

Seriously though, this version of the AI is based on a new and more reliable system. [b]Meaning there's still a lot of stuff we could improve and add.[/b] It's still radically better than the previous one, but we refrained ourself to put too much work on it. We wanted to [b]wait on your feedbacks[/b] and decide afterwards if the bot should benefit from a more elaborate education.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/5df0f5197248418af1f9515b5762063c207cb3b5.png[/img]
Working on the Bot allowed us to create a more tailored to our needs AI. Basically, it's like some sort of brain we can now put in whatever we want. Guess what? That's exactly what we did! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/931a8c69d32a5e2c41cc4d805fef1430b6ece9c7.gif[/img]

Those Mo0n minions can be destroyed while playing our new game modes: the trials! [b]Available for 1 or 2 players in coop,[/b] every trial has its own objective to complete. We designed those modes to give something fun to toy with, when learning to play. On their side, advanced players can challenge theirselves to unlock the best ranks for each trials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/40f33c4dd785371d8d49f906636d54a3f2fd8f0b.jpg[/img]

As for the new bot, we didn't commit heavily to create a big amount of trials. We have ideas for more of them but we're waiting on your feedbacks to see if that's something worth adding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/617376707198bbbc8f84df149153b6ba9f176766.png[/img]
While working on the trials, we needed more control over the procedurally generated levels. So we went back to this whole part of the game and did a few improvements.

We won't go much into details here, but let just say that [b]there's now a LOT more patterns available.[/b] This means, more diversity on the battlefied, more opportunities to get creative, in other words: more Ninza fun! We've also modified the amount of blocks spawned accordingly to the number of players. While playing 1vs1 you should expect more opportunities to crush your opponents, among a few other surprises ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/bbbb0a25773571016b482896b4894faf976c85cc.png[/img]
As usual, we've fixed some of the reported issues / bugs. We've also made a few adjustements regarding the characters balancing.

If you fancy taking a closer look on those, feel free to look at the #patchnote channel of our Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/cbc5ae7cd06e57c24144a420401e622631b71a68.png[/img]
Friendly reminder that our weekly online tournament is still up and running. So don't hesitate to join us for some good fights or to cheer up your favorite underdogs [url=http://www.twitch.tv/NinzaStreaming]on Twitch.[/url]

[code]WEEKLY TOURNAMENTS:
EVERY THURSDAY FROM 8:00 PM TO 9H30 PM (UTC +1)
REGISTRATIONS: 7:00 PM - 8:00 PM (on our Discord)[/code]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/d9ee5ef2eb56e9ac450f2c6caceb44b4a9b3444b.png[/img]
In summary, this update is expanding the offline experience of the game. Our goal was to give more opportunities for newcomers to enjoy and get better at Ninza without getting annihilated online. Rather than working heavily on one new feature, we've carefully implemented a new AI system. The idea was to build solid and flexible foundations so that we could easily add more content later, if needed. 

Indeed, the goal we're aiming for, is to have enough solo content to get a good first impression of the game. So, if the feedbacks ask for more solo content, we will be ready.

What we're planning to add next will change for sure the way you look at Ninza. This might be... some kind of final form? Anyway, thanks again a lot for patience and your amazing support!


From your Ninza Happiness Ninza Social Coordinator,

Wuthrer, Love <3

notes.title: New beta update: Jeanine joins the battle!
notes.content:
[b]Dear apprentice Ninzas,[/b]
We have good news and bad news... Indeed, it seems like the game has opened its battlefield to a very dark and mad creature which seems very enclined to annihilate our souls. Maybe the Mo0n was bored of being the only vilain of the whole ninzaverse? 

The good news being: [b]this dark badass is actually a playable character[/b] and is part of the update that just went live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/14ea701d51cdc31025466b86a93cfcedcb5b8391.png[/img]

[code]Ninza is in a open beta phase.
[url=http://www.ninza-game.com]Download the game from our official website,[/url] launch it and play.[/code]

So, let's take our little tour of the most important additions introduced by this new version!

[i]For a more detailed patch note, you can join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/awR8MRx]Discord server.[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/610d764e57101339a3bf7a449fc48a9c6c6f97d5.png[/img]
Voodoo magic allows her to fight like no other ninza! She summons the spirit of her old crow to haunt blocks. Once possessed, those blocks can be pushed in any direction, at anytime. Jeanine is an awesome character capable of setting up the most dangerous and unpredictable traps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/4be53fbe2d213f95150c764e6131fb4fa677a833.gif[/img]
[i]Haunt, push and kill![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/dddd163f178954f85e175e1023842f7f0037458a.gif[/img]
[i]Same goes for her hyper attack![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/121937fa93a9d5fffbd60cdf75cbe0b7ae9acb04.gif[/img]
[i]As for her mobility, let's say she's more of a "floaty" one.[/i]

Her attack mechanic really brings something fresh to the game, almost like a new way to to approach the game. We can't wait to see how far you'll push the full range of her capabilities. LET'S EMBRACE VOODOO MAGIC DEAR NINZAS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/1f4d6d8bf531d7ce16108d2c167ce80971bcc16b.png[/img]
From now on, Ninzas are entering a [i]spawning stasis[/i] when landing in the gamezone. Basically this a new state in which characters are sleeping and invulnerable. Players are free to get out of the spawning stasis at any time they want by pressing any button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/64944b782e1aab85895a809370ee999064cb7c28.gif[/img]
[i]A very rare footage of Kaitlyn being patient.[/i]

In the end, beginners have now more time to locate their character. On the other hand, more advanced players can anticipate their opponents spawning kill intentions and wait for the right moment to break the stasis. [b]More control, less frustration, more brain opportunites.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/bbbb0a25773571016b482896b4894faf976c85cc.png[/img]
As usual, we've fixed quite a number of reported issues / bugs. If you fancy taking a closer look on those, feel free to look at the #patchnote channel of our Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/cbc5ae7cd06e57c24144a420401e622631b71a68.png[/img]
Friendly reminder that our weekly online tournament is still up and running. So don't hesitate to join us for some good fights or to cheer up your favorite underdogs [url=http://www.twitch.tv/NinzaStreaming]on Twitch.[/url]

[code]WEEKLY TOURNAMENTS:
EVERY THURSDAY FROM 8:00 PM TO 9H30 PM (UTC +1)
REGISTRATIONS: 7:00 PM - 8:00 PM (on our Discord)[/code]

To join the tournaments, jump by our Discord and pick the @Online Player role to get notified when registrations open.

We're also planning to spice up the experience for spectators... but we need to become Twitch affiliate to do so :D

That's why we might throw some random twitch sessions in the upcoming days, to please the algorithm. If you're willing to help, subscribe to our channel and don't hesitate to come by to drop a line or two. The more, the faster we'll earn our affiliate badge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133981/d9ee5ef2eb56e9ac450f2c6caceb44b4a9b3444b.png[/img]
Thanks to recent feedbacks, we've realised that the tutorial we've added in a previous version wasn't simply enough for beginners. A lot of new players reported feeling lost when launching Ninza for the first time. They told us that they would really like to receive more guidance.

So that's what we're working on, our primary focus: [b]"how to make Ninza more welcoming for newcomers"[/b]. Indeed, discovering the game with friends, or during an event is definitely not the same experience as downloading the game and figuring things out all by yourself.

Sooooo, stay tuned! As soon as we'll have more stuff to share, you'll heard about it!


From your Ninza Happiness Ninza Social Coordinator,

Wuthrer, Love <3
